condition: OVERVIEW OF THE TREATMENT OF SOLID TUMOURS IN SURGICAL PRACTICE
text: Cancer incidence is increasing all over the world but most especially in low-and medium-income countries. Cancer is now one of the leading causes of death from non-communicable diseases. Effective modern treatment of cancer is best accomplished when different modalities of treatment like surgery, use of drugs, ionizing radiation and symptomatic palliation are brought together to complement each other.
